section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses for a single study examining the psychometric properties of the Romanian BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2). The main dataset was split into two subsamples: the first subsample (100 women and 100 men) was used for exploratory factor analysis (EFA) to assess the factor structure of BAS-2 scores separately by gender, and the second subsample (n = 243, with 112 women and 141 men) was used for confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). Additional analyses included measurement invariance testing across sex, internal consistency (Cronbach's α), test-retest reliability (n = 109), and convergent validity with other measures.
